content.short: PNTHN tracks DAO member reputations and showcases NFT projects they participated in on their PNTHN profile.
content.description: PNTHN is a LinkedIn-like platform built for the NFT ecosystem. It enables moderators, designers, community contributors, and others to showcase the NFT projects they have participated in directly on their PNTHN profiles. In addition, PNTHN leverages NFTs as credibility verification, introducing a distinctive approach to decentralized credentialing. By centralizing verifiable participation data, PNTHN helps artists, curators, and project teams demonstrate their involvement and build trust within the NFT community.
content.meta: PNTHN tracks DAO member reputations and builds credibility in the NFT space. Discover PNTHN and other DAO Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
